name: MSP_FRAME

payload_layout.note: MSPv1 serial frame, in order: '$' (0x24); 'M' (0x4D); a direction byte '<' (0x3C, request to the FC) / '>' (0x3E, normal reply) / '!' (0x21, error reply); size (u8 = payload length); command (u8); payload[size]; checksum (u8). The checksum is the XOR of the size byte, the command byte and every payload byte (V1_CHECKSUM_STARTPOS = 3: the checksum starts at the size byte, after '$','M',direction). Multi-byte payload integers are little-endian.

verification.method: Encoded and decoded by ade-protocol-msp frame round-trip and malformed-input tests. MOCK_EXERCISED checks our codec only.

licensing.note: Frame structure and checksum rule restated independently; no upstream code, comments, tables or fixtures copied.

notes: MSP_FRAME is the fixed local diagnostic phase token for validation of the recorded MSPv1 serial frame; it is not a command identifier.
